name: grimmsnarl_ml_v7
deck_note: The exact 60-card list is unchanged from v6.
ranker_note: Byte-identical to v6: the refreshed 2000-tree, 823-feature, 21-teacher imitation ranker. It remains the candidate generator.

policy_escalation.note: Exactly v6's routing table. The previous v7 Petrel/Stamp teacher route was removed.

value_model.deployment_gate: Disabled before turn 5 because early-turn test AUC is materially weaker.

counterfactual_search.rollout_policy: v6 ranker plus a fresh v6 fallback-policy tracker
counterfactual_search.leaf: terminal result or next player's public board
counterfactual_search.planner_guard: Never overrides an action already changed by the arithmetic dominance planner.
counterfactual_search.failure_mode: Any load/search/branch failure returns the v6 action.

policy: v6 generates and protects actions. From turn five, once per turn, only an ambiguous top-three MAIN candidate set is rolled to the end of the turn in the real engine. The public outcome value head may replace v6 only when its predicted gain is at least 0.06.
description: A replacement v7 that preserves v6's high-fidelity imitation and adds a conservative, actual-transition outcome-value layer instead of another narrow teacher pin.
